Format.description: The file's format name; first key of the file.

Version.description: The format version this build writes; older versions are migrated when read.

Name.description: Display name of the game; exported games name their user-data folder after it.

StartScene.description: Project-relative scene the game starts with; empty while none is chosen.

Window.description: The window of the exported game.

Scripting.description: Script VM limits and error behaviour.

Export.description: Contents and labelling of exported games.

WindowSettings.description: The window of the exported game.

Width.description: Initial client width of the window in pixels.

Height.description: Initial client height of the window in pixels.

VSync.description: Synchronizes presentation with the display's refresh.

Resizable.description: Lets the player resize the window.

SimulationSettings.description: The fixed-step simulation of play sessions.

MaxStepsPerFrame.description: Most fixed steps one frame runs; beyond it the simulation slows down instead of falling further behind.

Seed.description: The project half of each play session's random seed (Project Seed ^ Scene Seed).

MaxEntities.description: Most entities one play session may hold.

PhysicsSettings.description: World gravity and the collision layers of physics bodies.

Gravity.description: World gravity in metres per second squared; each component at most 1e12 in magnitude.

Layers.description: Collision layer names, unique and non-empty: 1 to 16, the first one "Default".

Collisions.description: Pairs of declared layer names whose bodies collide; unlisted pairs do not.

InputSettings.description: The input actions that scripts read by name.

Actions.description: Input actions by non-empty name, written sorted by name.

ShadowMapSize.description: Shadow map resolution in texels: a power of two from 256 to 8192.

SsaoHalfResolution.description: Computes ambient occlusion at half resolution.

ScriptingSettings.description: Limits and error behaviour of the script VM.

MemoryLimitMB.description: Soft memory limit of the script VM in megabytes (plus 16 MB headroom).

CallbackBudgetMs.description: Longest one script callback may run, in milliseconds; Dist raises a budget below 5000 ms to 5000 ms outside test runs.

PauseOnError.description: Pauses the play session when a script raises an error.

BlockPlayOnTypeErrors.description: Refuses to start play while the type checker reports errors.

ExportSettings.description: What an exported game contains and how its executable is labelled.

BuildScenes.description: Project-relative scenes the export loads strictly beside StartScene (each must be a registered scene file that loads strictly). They do not decide what ships: Data/Game.pak holds every registered asset below Assets/ except the Export.Exclude globs.

Exclude.description: Project-relative globs of assets left out of the export.

Icon.description: Project-relative square PNG used as the executable's icon, at least 256 x 256 pixels.

Version.description: Version of the exported game, in the form major.minor.patch.

Company.description: Company name written into the executable's resources: valid UTF-8 without control characters, U+FFFE or U+FFFF, at most 32000 bytes.

TestingSettings.description: The project's test suites and recorded replays.

Replays.description: Project-relative globs of the .replay files the test runner verifies.

CaseTimeoutTicks.description: Ticks after which a test case fails with a timeout.

SuiteTickLimit.description: Ticks after which a whole test suite fails with a timeout.

CoverageGates.description: Whether unfiltered test runs record coverage and fail on any gap of the per-mode coverage gates (FeatureTest).

InputAction.description: One named input action and the controls that drive it.

Bindings.description: Controls of a Button action, such as "Key.Space" or "Gamepad.South".

Positive.description: Controls that push an Axis action towards +1.

Negative.description: Controls that push an Axis action towards -1.

Gamepad.description: Gamepad axis of an Axis action, such as "Gamepad.LeftX"; empty for none.

Invert.description: Flips the sign of an Axis action.

TestSuite.description: One suite of the test runner.

Scene.description: Project-relative scene the suite runs in; empty runs it in an empty scene.

Parameters.description: Scene.Load parameters of the suite's scene: a JSON object, or null for none.

Isolation.description: Whether the cases share one play session or each gets a fresh one.

Clock.description: Frame deltas in seconds that select ScriptedClock, each >= 0 and at least one > 0; empty runs lockstep with ManualClock.

Overrides.description: Scripting limits that apply to this suite only.

ExpectQuit.description: Exit code the suite must end with through Application.Quit; -1: it must not quit.

Modes.description: Run modes the suite runs in, unique and non-empty.

TestSuiteOverrides.description: Scripting limits of one test suite, applied exactly (no Dist minimum).

CallbackBudgetMs.description: Callback budget of the suite in milliseconds: 0 uses the project setting, any other value is at least 10.

MemoryLimitMB.description: Script memory limit of the suite in megabytes: 0 uses the project setting.

PauseOnError.description: Accepted for compatibility: a script error never pauses a test run, whatever this override says.
